summary: Campus bus-zone kerb at a roundabout and zebra crossing, with no room to stop.
reasons: Bus Zone signs on this kerb
Roundabout exit, crossing and traffic island

drivers.seclusion: University buildings only, no dwellings within 48 m, but the kerb is open to campus foot traffic.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is a narrow lane edge beside a traffic island and a zebra crossing; no pull-off wide enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Campus bus route with a roundabout at one end; buses stop at the signed zone.
drivers.convention: Bus Zone signs both ways and no parked cars; the traffic parking control area ends here.

sun_shade: Mixed tree canopy west of the kerb and open to the sun from the east.

best_section.where: west kerb of Chancellors Place running up from the roundabout to the zebra crossing
